name: Ouji to Shitsuji to Assassin
source:
After fighting with her childhood friend Ouji, 18-year-old Nazuna fell off the stairs. And suddenly, she crashed with a rude yet handsome guy!

Nazuna goes back home only to discover that the prince Edward is on homestay in Japan and will live with her in her house! Also, he's brought his butler to stay with him, and Nazuna can't say no or her parents won't get the money from the homestay program!

Things will only get crazier when Prince Theodore and his butler also come into the picture... A romantic, royal comedy between the tenants at Nazuna's house!
translation:
18岁的那奈因与青梅竹马王子吵架，从楼梯上摔了下来。突然，她撞上了一个无礼却英俊的男孩！

那奈回到家后才发现，王子爱德华正在日本寄宿，将住进她家！他还带着自己的管家一同寄宿。那奈无法拒绝，否则她的父母就拿不到寄宿项目的报酬！

事情只会变得更加疯狂，因为西奥多王子和他的管家也加入了进来……发生在那奈家住客之间的浪漫王室喜剧！
